Dream 2026-11-22 linked 24 vignettes from 12 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · retells · "We will be using the evidence links a lot more." (Evidence links put to good use; references never overshadow the content)
- 2026-10-24 · touches · "The point if this is human text without bloat" (The first real essay: human text without bloat (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "An essay begins as a boundary. Then we add notes in this vignette form. These are the seeds of the essay" (Essays begin as a boundary of notes; conversation stays separate from the records that emerge (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "We are aiming to support the growth of meaning from a general exploration to specific argument" (An essay is a container for meaning that grows from exploration to argument; essays form families (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-29 · retells · "This can be in the agent assisted editor domain (but it's aso third party ready in taht domain)" (Domain, persona, problem and remedy: a first-time writer in the agent-assisted editor (2026-10-29))
- 2026-10-29 · touches · "I need to be able to expand or preview a draft paragraph without restoring it." (Essay editor: draft paragraphs cannot be reviewed without restoring them (2026-10-29))
- 2026-11-02 · touches · "A website editor needs to make clear statements that are backed up by evidence and other content." (Vignette 2026-11-02: a website editor is a sub-domain; its statements are backed and must not drift from the core materials)
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "The SRS essay editor allows for a managed human/AI collaboration context." (The essay editor is a technical implementation of the muDemocracy mindset shift; one URL that gets someone started (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-04 · touches · "basic building blocks that allow for structured semantic construction of writing" (The essay package holds the basic building blocks of structured writing (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "The essay editor preserves the human agency for owning the meaning." (The essay editor preserves human agency for owning meaning as individuals; muDemocracy is how we manage meaning as a group (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "Our focus for this work is currently the writing experience and sovereignty" (The essay editor is a shift: elsewhere types and fields carry the structure, here the focus is the writing experience and sovereignty (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "An editing tool that supports a writer to produce better work with AI." (The editor's domain in the owner's own words, written before reading the AI summaries: purpose, audience, boundary (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "The domain for the editor is not the domain for the application." (The editor's domain is not the application's: its audience holds onto their own words; get it written or develop the ideas, own words or feedback, support or challenge (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "The essay editor is about deeper meaning. The website is suface meaning." (Answering the challenger: agents add to the repo, the website is surface meaning, the middle path with AI, the container holds the rough work (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "The editor domain is about writing well, and collaborating with AI to create evidence backed writing - without letting the AI take over." (Non-addictive technology; the editor domain is writing well without letting AI take over; tools drive behaviour, and SemanticOps may make the feeling of things as easy to collect as numbers (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "talking about the domain of WG Agent-supported editor" (The funding goal is to show a community who want local AI; like muDemocracy, it is work and humans need to do their part (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "talking about the domain of WG Agent-supported editor" (Writing with AI is seductive: once I've read its words I can't imagine another direction, and the cognitive debt is real (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "talking about the domain of WG Agent-supported editor" (Not a tool for anyone: power tools that protect the individual's sovereignty; imagine AI is fire, and learn when it is useful (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "the words are not properly mine. And some I may not even recognise. There is cognitive debt" (Synthetic Logic: decades fused into a system with AI, and cognitive debt in the owner's own foundational work (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "We create the tooling to support the user, but we're not workign around the user." (We cannot control claude.ai's chat context, so we should not pretend: tooling supports the user, it doesn't work around them (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-08 · touches · "embedded images. Specifically in essays" (Vignette 2026-11-08: images come as a special paragraph, no wrap, SVG without scripts)
- 2026-11-10 · touches · "hover previews for notes and references with keep/deny on the card" (A shared paragraph's master always lives in the oldest owning essay; diverging is "Make a local copy" (2026-11-10))
- 2026-11-12 · touches · "An essay's pragraphs in one container. The comments in another. The references in another." (Vignette 2026-11-12: an essay as nested containers, wrapped for export)
- 2026-11-12 · touches · "I would prefer to move to an essay as a nested container set" (Vignette 2026-11-12: prefer an essay as a nested container set)
